cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Laboratory Manager to join our team. This position is responsible for overseeing the operations and administration of clinical laboratory testing for the Microbiology Department. The Laboratory Manager will also create, implement, and manage policies, procedures, and practices for optimal performance of the clinical diagnostics laboratory.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Direct the daily operational activities of the Microbiology lab; both the technical and non-technical operations
Effectively manage the staffing of the department and monitor the production schedule to ensure adequate coverage and proper use of overtime, and adjust as needed
Directly supervisor, train, and mentor laboratory supervisors and have ownership and responsibility for all departmental staff
Ensure the diagnostics laboratory provides market leading service levels, meeting the needs of our clients and corporate service metrics established for TAT
Resolve client inquiries and operational issues in a timely manner by consulting with the Medical Director, Technical Director, QA, other laboratory managers, discipline directors, laboratory directors or corporate operations
Ensure laboratory is compliant with corporate, state and federal regulatory requirements (CAP, CLIA, State, ISO, etc) related to personnel safety and quality of laboratory testing as well as professional conduct
Assist with developing and implementing laboratory procedures and installation of equipment and methods
Manage staff including recruiting & hiring qualified and enthusiastic employees, performance management, training and development
Ensure effective communication with leadership, clients, sales, corporate operations, as well as direct reports and all departmental staff
Conduct departmental meetings and ensure appropriate departmental communication
Investigate deviations from established procedures to ensure effective corrective action
Maintain technical knowledge in the assigned department(s) for the laboratory testing
Maintain a clean and safe work environment
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology or meet local regulatory (CLIA & State) requirements
Minimum 7 years of experience as a Technologist in a clinical diagnostics laboratory
Florida Supervisor License
Prior supervisor experience managing several direct reports
Strong working knowledge of CLIA, CAP and relevant state regulations
Understanding of laboratory operations as well as policies and procedures
Proven success in training and developing both technical and non-technical employees
Ability to problem solve and provide solutions under minimal supervision
Proficient with Laboratory Information Systems and Microsoft Office
Strong communication skills; both written and verbal
High level of attention to detail with strong organizational skills
Ability to handle the physical requirements of the position
Preferred Requirements
Previous experience managing people leaders
ASCP certification
Experience in a high volume clinical laboratory environment
Comfortability making decisions in a changing environment
If you're looking for a career that offers opportunities for growth, continual development, professional challenge and the chance to make a real difference, apply today!

cond_0090.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Laboratory Manager to join our team at [Company name masked]. This position works alongside department staff and leadership to oversee the operations and administration of clinical laboratory testing for the Microbiology Department. The Laboratory Manager will coordinate with the team to create, implement, and manage the policies, procedures, and practices that support optimal performance of the clinical diagnostics laboratory.
Florida Supervisor License and minimum 7 years of experience in Microbiology at a clinical diagnostics laboratory are required.
cond_0090.responsibilities:

Coordinate the daily operational activities of the Microbiology lab, covering both technical and non-technical operations
Work with the department to manage staffing and monitor the production schedule to ensure adequate coverage and proper use of overtime, adjusting as needed
Supervise, train, and mentor laboratory supervisors, sharing responsibility for all departmental staff

Manage staff including recruiting and hiring qualified employees, performance management, training, and development
Facilitate effective communication with leadership, clients, sales, corporate operations, direct reports, and all departmental staff

Maintain a clean and safe work environment

Florida Supervisor License required

Florida Supervisor License

The Laboratory Manager will create, implement, and manage policies, procedures, and practices for optimal performance of the clinical diagnostics laboratory. Florida Supervisor License and a minimum of 7 years of experience in Microbiology at a clinical diagnostics laboratory are required.
cond_0267.responsibilities:
Direct the daily operational activities of the Microbiology lab, covering both technical and non-technical operations, staying in close contact with staff throughout the day.
Actively manage department staffing and monitor the production schedule to ensure adequate coverage and proper use of overtime, adjusting as needed.
Directly supervise, train, and mentor laboratory supervisors, taking ownership and responsibility for all departmental staff through regular one-on-one and group interactions.
Ensure the diagnostics laboratory provides market-leading service levels, meeting client needs and corporate service metrics established for TAT.
Resolve client inquiries and operational issues in a timely manner by consulting daily with the Medical Director, Technical Director, QA, other laboratory managers, discipline directors, laboratory directors, or corporate operations.
Ensure the laboratory is compliant with corporate, state, and federal regulatory requirements (CAP, CLIA, State, ISO, etc.) related to personnel safety, quality of laboratory testing, and professional conduct.
Assist with developing and implementing laboratory procedures and installation of equipment and methods.
Manage staff including recruiting and hiring qualified employees, performance management, training, and development.
Maintain ongoing, effective communication with leadership, clients, sales, corporate operations, direct reports, and all departmental staff.
Conduct departmental meetings regularly and ensure appropriate departmental communication, actively contributing to discussions and raising issues early.
Investigate deviations from established procedures and initiate corrective action discussions with relevant parties.
Maintain technical knowledge in the assigned department(s) for laboratory testing.
Maintain a clean and safe work environment.

cond_0486.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Laboratory Manager to join our team at [Company name masked]. This position works alongside department staff and leadership to oversee the operations and administration of clinical laboratory testing for the Microbiology Department. The Laboratory Manager will coordinate with the team to create, implement, and manage the policies, procedures, and practices that support optimal performance of the clinical diagnostics laboratory.
Florida Supervisor License and minimum 7 years of experience in Microbiology at a clinical diagnostics laboratory are required.
cond_0486.responsibilities:
Job Duties/Responsibilities
Coordinate the daily operational activities of the Microbiology lab, covering both technical and non-technical operations
Work with the department to manage staffing and monitor the production schedule to ensure adequate coverage and proper use of overtime, adjusting as needed
Supervise, train, and mentor laboratory supervisors, sharing responsibility for all departmental staff
Work with the team to ensure the diagnostics laboratory provides market leading service levels, meeting the needs of clients and corporate service metrics established for TAT
Resolve client inquiries and operational issues in a timely manner by consulting with the Medical Director, Technical Director, QA, other laboratory managers, discipline directors, laboratory directors, or corporate operations
Help ensure the laboratory remains compliant with corporate, state, and federal regulatory requirements (CAP, CLIA, State, ISO, etc.) related to personnel safety, quality of laboratory testing, and professional conduct
Assist with developing and implementing laboratory procedures and installation of equipment and methods
Manage staff including recruiting and hiring qualified employees, performance management, training, and development
Facilitate effective communication with leadership, clients, sales, corporate operations, direct reports, and all departmental staff
Conduct departmental meetings and support appropriate departmental communication
Investigate deviations from established procedures in coordination with relevant stakeholders to ensure effective corrective action
Maintain technical knowledge in the assigned department(s) for laboratory testing
Maintain a clean and safe work environment
cond_0486.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology or meet local regulatory (CLIA & State) requirements
Minimum 7 years of experience as a Technologist in a clinical diagnostics laboratory
Florida Supervisor License required
Prior supervisor experience managing several direct reports
Previous experience managing people leaders is a plus
ASCP certification is required/preferred
Experience in a high volume clinical laboratory environment is preferred
Strong working knowledge of CLIA, CAP and relevant state regulations
Understanding of laboratory operations as well as policies and procedures
Proven success in training and developing both technical and non-technical employees
Ability to problem solve and provide solutions under minimal supervision
Proficient with Laboratory Information Systems and Microsoft Office
Strong communication skills; both written and verbal
High level of attention to detail with strong organizational skills
Comfortability making decisions in a changing environment
Ability to handle the physical requirements of the position
